name: Organisation Identification 4
definition: Unique and unambiguous way to identify an organisation.

BICOrBEI.name: BIC Or BEI
BICOrBEI.definition: Code allocated to a financial institution or non financial institution by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority as described in ISO 9362 "Banking - Banking telecommunication messages - Business identifier code (BIC)".

Other.name: Other
Other.definition: Unique identification of an organisation, as assigned by an institution, using an identification scheme.
